drivers: Mixed refinery outages and restarts (Deer Park outage vs Flint Hills, Valero restarts)
Petcoke rally above US$100 on energy strength
outlooks.summary: Supply signals are mixed: new outages are offset by several coker restarts, and the net supply-pressure score is near zero. Price is down 16% over 3 months, so a shortage is not clearly building.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how long the Deer Park outage lasts and whether US Gulf freight rates stay high.
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与重启并存(Deer Park停产,Flint Hills、Valero重启)
能源走强带动石油焦反弹至100美元以上
运费高企抑制美国出口
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应信号好坏参半:新的停产被多套焦化装置重启所抵消,净供应压力得分接近零。价格三个月下跌16%,短缺并未明显形成。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注Deer Park炼厂停产持续时间,以及美湾运费是否维持高位。

drivers: DRC export quotas cutting output (Glencore cobalt down 52%)
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are sharply cutting supply, and China export-control uncertainty adds risk. Price has fallen recently, so the shortage is not fully priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota adjustments and any China decision on ending its export-ban pause.
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额压减产量(嘉能可钴产量下降52%)
中国出口管制到期节点
价格三个月已下跌24%
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)配额大幅压减供应,中国出口管制的不确定性带来额外风险。近期价格已回落,短缺因素尚未完全计入价格。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额调整,以及中国是否决定结束出口禁令暂停期。

drivers: Copper-moly giant slowing molybdenum output growth
outlooks.summary: A major producer is holding back output growth and China export policy is uncertain. Price is already up sharply, so part of the tightness may be priced in, but more upside is possible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control decisions and output guidance from major copper-moly miners.
drivers_zh: 大型铜钼企业放缓钼产量增长
中国出口管制到期节点
价格三个月上涨18%
outlooks.summary_zh: 主要生产商抑制产量增长,中国出口政策存在不确定性。价格已大幅上涨,部分紧张可能已被计入,但仍有上行空间。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制决定以及大型铜钼矿企的产量指引。

outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly general critical-minerals policy news with little lithium-specific supply disruption. Supply additions such as CATL's project offset the risk.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for lithium-specific mine cuts or China export-control changes.
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制的一般性消息
宁德时代上游扩产
价格三个月下跌13%
outlooks.summary_zh: 消息多为关键矿产政策的泛泛报道,缺少锂本身的供应中断。宁德时代等新增供应抵消了部分风险。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注锂矿减产或中国出口管制变化等锂专属消息。

drivers: China extended pause only to January
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages and curbs on Japan point to tight supply in some products. China's two-month extension of the pause eases broad risk, but it is short and the deadline returns.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the January deadline and any easing of China's curbs on Japan.
drivers_zh: 日本钇供应“停滞”
中国对日本的出口管制
中国仅将暂停期延长至1月
outlooks.summary_zh: 钇短缺和对日限制显示部分品种供应偏紧。中国将暂停期延长两个月缓解了整体风险,但期限较短,截止日期将再度临近。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注1月的截止日期,以及中国对日限制是否放松。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeezing supply
outlooks.summary: Supply disruptions in Congo and Indonesia and strong demand point to continued tightness. Price is already up strongly over 12 months but flat over 3 months, so further upside is plausible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Congo conflict developments and Indonesian export and output data.
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产收紧供应
需求增长快于精炼锡供应
价格12个月上涨56%
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果和印尼的供应中断加上强劲需求,意味着供应持续偏紧。价格12个月涨幅已大,但近三个月持平,仍有进一步上行可能。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果冲突进展以及印尼出口和产量数据。

outlooks.summary: Export-deadline headlines add some risk, but the price is down sharply and there is no specific outage. The balance looks neutral.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the antimony export deadline and any China licensing changes.
drivers_zh: 出口截止日期临近
中国出口管制的一般性消息
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口截止日期的消息带来一定风险,但价格大幅下跌且无具体停产事件,整体偏中性。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注锑出口截止日期以及中国许可政策的变化。

outlooks.summary: Export-control deadlines and tight minor-metal supply keep risk to the upside. The price has already jumped 67% in 3 months, so some of this is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's November 27 deadline and any export-license changes.
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制截止日期(镓为11月27日)
铟等小金属市场偏紧
价格三个月上涨67%
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口管制截止日期和小金属供应偏紧使风险偏向上行。价格三个月已大涨67%,部分因素已被计入。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国11月27日的截止日期及出口许可变化。

drivers: Anode costs rising on feedstock rally
outlooks.summary: Green coke supply signals are mixed and the net score is near zero. Rising anode costs support prices, but the shortage case is weak.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Deer Park recovery and green coke prices as a cost driver.
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与重启并存
原料上涨推高阳极成本
价格三个月上涨15%
outlooks.summary_zh: 生焦供应信号好坏参半,净得分接近零。阳极成本上升支撑价格,但短缺的依据不足。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注Deer Park炼厂恢复情况以及作为成本驱动的生焦价格。

outlooks.summary: Refinery outages are offset by restarts and the supply-pressure score is near zero. The index is slightly lower over 3 months, so there is no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US refinery outages and freight rates.
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与重启并存
能源板块上涨
价格三个月下跌5%
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂停产被重启所抵消,供应压力得分接近零。指数三个月小幅下跌,没有明确的短缺信号。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国炼厂停产情况和运费走势。
